name: answer-relevancy-benchmark-vitaminc-dataset
description: A collection of human-annotated judgments for whether candidate answers are relevant to given questions, intended to evaluate models' ability to detect and rank relevant answers. Measures answer relevancy and ranking robustness across diverse question-answer pairs. Useful for evaluating retrieval rerankers, answer filtering, and downstream QA systems.
reputation: A small, task-specific dataset with limited but growing use in retrieval and answer-ranking evaluation communities.
